metadata.description: Research-grade dataset of Japanese era proclamation dates with proleptic-Gregorian equivalents, sourced from primary chronicles, government proclamations, and ja.wikipedia (last-resort baseline). Includes both Northern Court (北朝) and Southern Court (南朝) eras of the Nanboku-chō period.

field_reference.best_pg: ★ Recommended PG date for Localize to publish. Equals western.pg where available (since it reflects the historical Japanese calendar); falls back to calendrical_pg.
field_reference.calendrical_pg: PG date computed independently from the lunisolar (year=west_Y-644, month, day) via Calendrical.LunarJapanese → Calendar.ISO. Astronomical reconstruction.
field_reference.citations: List of citation references; each has key (resolves to bibliography) and optional quote/note/source_url
field_reference.cldr_raw: Current entry in priv/localize/supplemental_data/calendars.etf as [Y, M, D]
field_reference.court: northern (北朝) | southern (南朝) | unified (pre-1336 and post-1392)
field_reference.era: Era name in Japanese kanji (元号)
field_reference.idx: CLDR era index (0-236; 232+ are Meiji onwards)
field_reference.lunisolar: Proclamation date as recorded in the chronicle, with prev_era/prev_year/month/day/leap_month and a display string
field_reference.pg_disagreement_days: Days between western.pg and calendrical_pg (only present when they disagree)
field_reference.private_era: True for 私年号 (folk/private era) entries
field_reference.recommended_cldr_correction: Where I have high confidence CLDR is wrong, the recommended replacement triple
field_reference.romaji: Romanized reading (modern Hepburn), provided where I have it
field_reference.western: Western date per ja.wikipedia: {date, calendar=julian|gregorian, pg=proleptic-Gregorian}

metadata.methodology_summary: For each pre-Meiji era: (1) Read lunisolar proclamation date from the Wikipedia table (cross-referenced with primary chronicles where possible). (2) Compute wiki_pg by Julian→PG (pre-1582) or as-is (Gregorian). (3) Compute calendrical_pg independently from lunisolar via Calendrical.LunarJapanese. (4) Where they agree, mark provisional. Where they disagree (usually ±1 month due to historical intercalary-month placement differences), prefer wiki_pg and mark disputed. For 15 rows with direct primary-source citations or formal government proclamations, mark verified.
